payload.scientific_question: Does greater split-clean molecular training density improve the COMPOSE CNOF de novo quality-diversity frontier without weakening exact committed-state validity?
payload.authorization_basis: The user requested a comparable pretrained COMPOSE molecular prior and explicitly approved generic de novo sampler controls; this contract limits the first causal data-scale comparison.

scope.generated_object: connected complete neutral CNOF MolecularGraph with at most 40 active atoms, represented by the exact persistent-slot rewrite executor

matched_training.source_size_law: same empirical law from first 50000 frozen training molecules
matched_training.architecture_optimizer_and_executor: identical across arms; asserted by tests/test_denovo_prior_scale_recipes.py

gates.before_launch: verify physical hashes, self-hash, recipes' only permitted differences, immutable run labels, and Modal source/manifest mounts
gates.checkpoint_selection: validation criterion only; final IID and scaffold-held-out test values must not select an architecture, checkpoint, temperature, or noise setting
gates.sampler_selection: separate predeclared development sweep after training; no hidden oversampling or QED/SA acceptance filter
gates.paper_claim: none until exact official evaluator and full molecule/provenance persistence pass
gates.quality_improvement_denominator: all generation attempts on matched development seeds
gates.negative_result: if the larger arm fails any floor or improves joint quality by less than 0.05 absolute, do not promote a scale claim
